case.caption: Daniel Burciaga v. The Geo Group Inc
case.metadata_warning: Cause and nature-of-suit fields are classifications, not proof of the complaint's allegations.

public_case_document.permitted_use: A mandatory settlement conference was scheduled and its discussions were off record, privileged, and confidential.

later_federal_sources.description: Judge Ronnie Abrams's March 28, 2023 opinion and order in United States ex rel. Hart v. McKesson Corp., No. 15-cv-0903 (RA), 2023 WL 2663528, Dkt. 190 (S.D.N.Y.), reproduced in Supreme Court petition appendix No. 23-1293

later_federal_sources.description: Executive Office for United States Attorneys, DOJ Journal of Federal Law and Practice, volume 70, number 3, Combatting Health-Care Fraud (August 2022), page 55
later_federal_sources.evidence_class: official DOJ quotation of unavailable Burciaga holding
later_federal_sources.quote: A defendant should not be permitted to ‘take advantage of [its] own wrong’ by making its liability hinge on the Government’s ability to detect something that is designed to be difficult to detect.
